replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Honestly, math feels like a distant relative I barely recognize. It's a necessary evil rather than a passion, something I've managed to get by with but never truly embraced or explored deeply.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. When numbers start piling up or equations look intimidating, I feel a knot in my stomach. My high neuroticism makes me worry about failing or not understanding things quickly. I avoid it when possible because the fear of making a mistake or looking foolish in front of others creates a lot of unnecessary stress for me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math learning recently. My experience with technology in education has mostly been limited to using it for research on literature or biology. I prefer to stick to traditional methods or ask friends for help since I'm naturally more introverted. I find the idea of relying on a machine for complex math a bit unsettling given my anxieties.

I usually prefer explaining things through words rather than complex formulas since math isn't my strongest suit.
